Discover_prague_with_walterin_0f481622-5.en: The Walterin Prague book standing on a teal background. Its yellow scalloped cover shows a winged figure holding a beer, under the words “Walterin Prague — page by page stories, by cartoonist Walter Ihring”. The caption reads “Discover cities with Walterin — uncover stories of cities and get your own Walterin today!”
Discover_prague_with_walterin_0f481622-5.sk: Kniha Walterin Praha na zelenomodrom pozadí. Na žltej vlnkovanej obálke je okrídlená postavička s pivom a nápis „Walterin Prague — page by page stories, by cartoonist Walter Ihring“. Text v obrázku znie „Discover cities with Walterin — uncover stories of cities and get your own Walterin today!“

HOMEPAGE_phone_a562b586-b879-413b-948a-4.en: The same scene cropped for a phone: the Walterin Prague book on a teal background, yellow scalloped cover with a winged figure holding a beer, and the caption “Discover cities with Walterin — uncover stories of cities and get your own Walterin today!”
HOMEPAGE_phone_a562b586-b879-413b-948a-4.sk: Tá istá scéna orezaná pre telefón: kniha Walterin Praha na zelenomodrom pozadí, žltá vlnkovaná obálka s okrídlenou postavičkou s pivom a text „Discover cities with Walterin — uncover stories of cities and get your own Walterin today!“

Page_by_page_128c1900-ed10-4dbb-8ee4-4cb.en: A tablet lying on a grey cushion with a stylus beside it, showing a page of Walterin Prague — the Charles IV story told in nine frames. The caption reads “Page by page stories — explore capital cities through short stories in frames.”
Page_by_page_128c1900-ed10-4dbb-8ee4-4cb.sk: Tablet na sivom vankúši, vedľa neho dotykové pero. Na obrazovke je strana z knihy Walterin Praha — príbeh Karola IV. v deviatich okienkach. Text v obrázku znie „Page by page stories — explore capital cities through short stories in frames.“

HOMEPAGE_phone2_5b723083-bbc8-40a0-8fdb-.en: The same scene cropped for a phone: a tablet on a grey cushion showing the Charles IV story from Walterin Prague in nine frames, with the caption “Page by page stories — explore capital cities through short stories in frames.”
HOMEPAGE_phone2_5b723083-bbc8-40a0-8fdb-.sk: Tá istá scéna orezaná pre telefón: tablet na sivom vankúši so stranou o Karolovi IV. z knihy Walterin Praha v deviatich okienkach a text „Page by page stories — explore capital cities through short stories in frames.“

Daily_Inpiration_with_prague_tarot_8f62a.en: A phone standing in afternoon sunlight against a pale wall, showing the Charles IV story from Walterin Prague in nine frames. The caption reads “Your best friend — be inspired by the city’s most captivating tales.”
Daily_Inpiration_with_prague_tarot_8f62a.sk: Telefón opretý o svetlú stenu v popoludňajšom slnku, na obrazovke príbeh Karola IV. z knihy Walterin Praha v deviatich okienkach. Text v obrázku znie „Your best friend — be inspired by the city’s most captivating tales.“

HOMEPAGE_phone3_0bdd1018-e787-4ee2-9587-.en: The same scene cropped for a phone: a phone in sunlight showing the Charles IV story from Walterin Prague, with the caption “Your best friend — be inspired by the city’s most captivating tales.”
HOMEPAGE_phone3_0bdd1018-e787-4ee2-9587-.sk: Tá istá scéna orezaná pre telefón: telefón na slnku so stranou o Karolovi IV. z knihy Walterin Praha a text „Your best friend — be inspired by the city’s most captivating tales.“

Group_1060.png.en: A drawing headed “Illustration”: a woolly sheep with one curved horn, on a pink ground.
Group_1060.png.sk: Kresba s nadpisom „Illustration“: huňatá ovca s jedným zahnutým rohom na ružovom pozadí.

Group_673.png.en: A drawing headed “Exploring”: the Eiffel Tower, dated 1889 and marked 324 m, beside a green hill of the same height with a small tower on top, dated 1891 and marked 60 m.
Group_673.png.sk: Kresba s nadpisom „Exploring“: Eiffelova veža s rokom 1889 a výškou 324 m a vedľa nej rovnako vysoký zelený kopec s malou vežou na vrchole, s rokom 1891 a výškou 60 m.

Group_674.png.en: A drawing headed “Humour”: a running character in a yellow cap with a wide open red mouth, on a yellow ground.
Group_674.png.sk: Kresba s nadpisom „Humour“: bežiaca postavička v žltej čiapke so široko otvorenými červenými ústami, na žltom pozadí.

Group_676.png.en: A drawing headed “History”: a yellow hilltop town of towers and rooftops under a pale blue sky, with a road winding up to it.
Group_676.png.sk: Kresba s nadpisom „History“: žlté mesto plné veží a striech na kopci pod bledomodrou oblohou, k nemu sa vinie cesta.

illustrated_biography_pixel_e4117d82-046.en: Walter Ihring’s illustrated autobiography, headed “My illustrated biography”: a tall grid of small drawn panels, each labelled with a word — 1969, Mama, Tata, Egypt, School, Football, Beatrix, For the homeland, Dreaming, India, Veronika, Walto, Nepal, Coffee.
illustrated_biography_pixel_e4117d82-046.sk: Ilustrovaný životopis Waltera Ihringa s nadpisom „My illustrated biography“: vysoká mriežka malých kreslených okienok, každé s jedným slovom — 1969, Mama, Tata, Egypt, School, Football, Beatrix, For the homeland, Dreaming, India, Veronika, Walto, Nepal, Coffee.
